summary_md: **JudicialMind ([@JudicialMind_](https://x.com/JudicialMind_/status/2115483736913699069))** releases **Counsel-27B**, a legal and general model tuned to think less and call tools better, claiming 4.3x speed on one GPU (~220 tok/s) and 6x on two; weights are on Hugging Face, with a follow-up reply.
relevance: A ~30B open model explicitly tuned for shorter reasoning and tool use: the agent-friendly trade-off.
